import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tarfile

ROOT = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'crates/joil-core/tests'))
from truth_ev12_capture import capture_case, digest
from truth_ev12_capture_test import synthetic_case
from analysis.case_identity import finalize_case_identity, verify_case_identity

work = ROOT / 'target/truth-ev12-capture-support/synthetic-archive-restore-v1'
work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
case = synthetic_case(work)
identity = finalize_case_identity(case)
capture = work / 'captured-inputs'
receipt = capture_case(case, capture)
archive = work / 'synthetic-inputs.tar'
with tarfile.open(archive, 'x') as stream:
    stream.add(capture, arcname='restored-inputs')
archive_digest = digest(archive)
for source, name in [(case, 'original-mesh-preserved'), (capture, 'capture-mesh-preserved')]:
    (source / 'constant/polyMesh').rename(work / name)
    try:
        verify_case_identity(source)
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError('pruned source was incorrectly verified')
with tarfile.open(archive, 'r') as stream:
    stream.extractall(work, filter='data')
restored = work / 'restored-inputs'
verified = verify_case_identity(restored)
assert (restored / 'case-identity.json').read_bytes() == (case / 'case-identity.json').read_bytes()
for name, expected in receipt['files'].items():
    assert digest(restored / name) == expected, name
assert verified['case_hash'] == identity['case_hash']
assert verified['mesh_hash'] == identity['mesh_hash']
output = {
    'kind': 'synthetic_archive_restore_durability_not_simulation_or_validation',
    'capture_receipt_sha256': digest(restored / 'tr-ev12-capture-receipt.json'),
    'archive': archive_digest,
    'exact_restored_files': receipt['file_count'],
    'exact_restored_bytes': receipt['total_bytes'],
    'chain': receipt['chain'],
    'negative': 'original and capture missing polyMesh both refused before restore',
    'positive': verified,
    'retained_evidence': str(work.relative_to(ROOT)),
}
print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))
